airflow.name: Apache Airflow
airflow.status: Stable; mature platform for scheduled, finite batch workflows
airflow.judgementReason: Mature and widely supported for scheduled, finite batch workflows; consider alternatives for highly dynamic, decentralised or continuously running event-stream workloads.
description: Open-source platform for developing, scheduling and monitoring batch-oriented workflows as directed acyclic graphs.

prefect.name: Prefect
prefect.status: Actively maintained open-source workflow orchestration platform
prefect.judgementReason: Python-native orchestration with dynamic workflows, retries, state tracking and transactional controls; promising for data pipelines, but independent evidence remains limited and governance is vendor-led.
description: Python-native workflow orchestration platform providing tracked states, retries, caching and transactional workflow controls.

temporal.name: Temporal
temporal.judgementReason: Strong choice when durable execution, recovery and long-running workflow state are primary requirements; less data-pipeline-specific than conventional orchestrators and requires additional operational commitment.
description: Durable-execution platform that persists workflow state and resumes execution after process or infrastructure failure.
